# TWSGurukulX — Trading Insights Blog
> Live stream trading analysis and market insights from Trading With Sidhant Team

## Important Pages

- https://blogs.twsgurukul.com/ : Homepage with latest trading session recaps and market analysis
- https://blogs.twsgurukul.com/about : About TWSGurukulX, who we are, what we cover, and contact info
- https://blogs.twsgurukul.com/feed.xml : RSS feed with all posts in chronological order
- https://blogs.twsgurukul.com/sitemap.xml : Full sitemap with all posts and tag archives

## Content Structure

Posts are auto-generated recaps of live trading streams on YouTube by Trading With Sidhant Team. Each post covers:
- Nifty, BankNifty, and options analysis
- Key levels, setups, and chart annotations
- Market context and trading insights

## Tag Archives

Tag pages at /tags/{tag} group posts by topic. Common tags include market analysis, options trading, Nifty, BankNifty, and specific trading strategies.

## API

The /api/ path is private and not intended for crawling.
